Gross margin is typically a metric more relevant for companies in manufacturing or retail sectors where the cost of goods sold (COGS) is a significant factor in determining profitability. Instead, metrics such as net interest margin, return on equity (ROE), and efficiency ratio are more commonly used to assess performance in the banking sector.
